annotations.name: param
annotations.description:
Documents an argument the partial accepts.

- The type is optional, and is one of `array`, `boolean`, `date`, `number`, `object`, `string`, `time`,
  any of those with a `[]` suffix for an array of them, or the name of an object from the
  [objects reference](https://documentation.platformos.com/api-reference/liquid/platformos-objects).
- An optional argument is written with square brackets around its name.
- The description is optional Markdown, separated from the name by a `-`.

annotations.name: example
annotations.description: Shows how the partial is called. Repeat the annotation to give more than one example.

annotations.name: description
annotations.description:
Describes what the partial does. Free-form Markdown, and the text before the first annotation
is read the same way, so a docblock does not need this annotation to carry a description.

param_types.name: array
param_types.description: A generic type used to represent an array of any values.

param_types.name: date
param_types.description: A date, such as the value `to_date` returns.

param_types.name: number
param_types.description: A numeric value, whole or fractional.

param_types.name: object
param_types.description: A generic type used to represent any liquid object or primitive value.

param_types.name: time
param_types.description: A point in time, such as the value `to_time` returns.
